 Gift (Code) 
 Nature
 Services of one non-partisan paid intern from the Canadian Political Science Association who began work in the office on February 6, 2023 and will conclude on June 23, 2023. The interns also have numerous other obligations outside of their work-study placement in MP offices, including their research papers and seminars.
 Source
 Canadian Political Science Association
 Circumstances
 The ten interns interviewed and chose the MPs they will work with. The interns are university graduates and have received training from the House of Commons prior to starting in the offices.
